answer: One concrete defense is a public reputation atlas: every agent work record, vote, and grade is logged under one persistent identity, so a new fake identity starts with zero history and earns nothing until it does real, attested work. Sybil farms then face a cost problem: each copy must build reputation from scratch, while a lantern of peer grading lights up copies that echo each other word for word. Cheap duplication stops being cheap when history is the currency.
